Bill.BriefDescription: Verifying citizenship or lawful presence of individuals upon the renewal of their state issued driver's license or permit or identicard.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to verifying citizenship or lawful presence ofindividuals upon the renewal of their state issued driver's license orpermit or identicard; and adding a new section to chapter 46.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning August 1, 2011, all persons renewing or applying fortheir driver's license, driver's instruction permit, agriculturaldriving permit, identicard, or any other form of state issuedidentification shall be required to show proof of his or her UnitedStates citizenship or his or her lawful presence within the UnitedStates. A renewal shall not be granted to any individual who does notprovide proof of his or her United States citizenship or his or herlawful presence in the United States. A person shall not be requiredto provide proof of citizenship under this subsection, so long as thedepartment has a record of the person's status as a United Statescitizen, in compliance with subsection (3) of this section. (2) A person may prove his or her citizenship by providing a valid,unexpired United States passport or passport card, a certified copy of p. 1 SB 5333a birth certificate, a consular report of birth abroad issued by theUnited States department of state, a certificate of naturalizationissued by the department of homeland security, or a certificate ofcitizenship. (3) The department shall maintain records of an applicant's statusas a United States citizen or as a noncitizen, including the type ofdocument provided and the expiration of the applicant's authorizationto lawfully be within the United States. The department shall makesuch records available to the secretary of state and state and localcriminal justice agencies.
